[Regarding Unsupervised]: Tesla has major architectural improvements underway that they want to finish testing and deploy to vehicles before they release large-scale unsupervised Full Self-Driving.

Thus, the end-of-year timeline, alongside the release of Full Self-Driving V15.
"What is deployed in the Netherlands and Europe [Full Self-Driving] is the exact same architecture and training procedure as in North America, but with more data from the region."

Full Self-Driving V15 will come out later this year or early next year and will run on the latest hardware (AI4).

There are no plans to bring AI5 (recently tapped out) to customer vehicles for the foreseeable future.

The official plan for HW3 (as of @Tesla's Q1 Call):

– V14 Lite is expected in June, which will include all major features currently available in V14.X.

– A hardware upgrade from HW3 to AI4 (Autopilot Computer and Cameras) will be available.

– And better trade-in offers.

"How will HW3 vehicles reach Unsupervised Full Self-Driving?"

– HW3 does not have the capability to achieve Unsupervised Full Self-Driving.

– Customers will be offered a discounted trade-in and the ability to upgrade the Autopilot hardware and cameras.


Teslascope (@teslascope)

Today is @Tesla's Q1 Earnings Call!

We'll be spotlighting information on software, Full Self-Driving, and Autopilot Hardware (HW3, AI4, and AI5).

– A distilled V14 build will be released in the interim for HW3 "V14 Lite", which will include the majority of features currently available in AI4. Coming in June.

– A "microfactory" in metropolitan cities to upgrade existing vehicles, as service centers can be overwhelmed.
